'''Fumihiko Tachiki''' (Japanese: '''立木文彦''' ''Tachiki Fumihiko'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tachiki was born on April 29, 1961 in {{wp|Nagasaki Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. His first role in {{aniseries|PTS}} was that of [[Lt. Surge]] during {{aniseries|OS}}. Later, in {{aniseries|RS}}, he had gained two more important roles, portraying [[Professor Birch]] and [[Brock's Ludicolo]]. In his personal life, Tachiki formed a band with fellow voice actor [[Toshiyuki Morikawa]], called "2HEARTS".
